svg.title: Microservices architecture, each service owning its own database
svg.desc: Web and mobile clients call an API gateway, which routes to the auth, user, product and order services. Each service reads and writes only its own database. The product service also reads a Redis cache; the order service enqueues to a message queue and calls the payment service.
